intent: The meta-skill: authors a new Factory skill as a generator-owned SKILL.md.tmpl (never an orphan SKILL.md), or optimises one by hill-climb (one change at a time, kept only on improvement), composing self-improving-agent-skills and passing quality-governance before anything lands.

dimensions.name: generator-owned
dimensions.criterion: A new skill is a SKILL.md.tmpl that flows through gen:skills; never an orphan SKILL.md.

dimensions.name: governance-gate
dimensions.criterion: Nothing lands without a quality-governance readiness review.

dimensions.name: hill-climb-optimise
dimensions.criterion: Optimises one change at a time, keeping it only if the measured score improves.

dimensions.name: authoring-standard
dimensions.criterion: Enforces the authoring standard: folder==name, Do-not-activate, single responsibility, ≤500 lines.

dimensions.name: composes-self-improving
dimensions.criterion: Runs the self-improving-agent-skills execute-diagnose-mutate loop for optimisation.
